name: Aluminum Gas
description: (Al) Aluminum Gas is a low density Metal heated into a Gaseous state.

name: Carbon Dioxide
description:
(CO2) Carbon Dioxide is an atomically heavy chemical compound in a Gaseous state.

It tends to sink below other gases.

name: Carbon Gas
description: (C) Carbon is an abundant, versatile element heated into a Gaseous state.

name: Chlorine Gas
description: (Cl) Chlorine is a natural Germ-killing element in a Gaseous state.

name: Cobalt Gas
description: (Co) Cobalt is a Refined Metal, heated into a Gas.

name: Copper Gas
description: (Cu) Copper Gas is a conductive Metal heated into a Gas state.

name: Ethanol Gas
description: (C2H6O) Ethanol Gas is an advanced chemical compound heated into a Gaseous state.

name: Gold Gas
description: (Au) Gold Gas is a conductive precious Metal, heated into a Gaseous state.

name: Hydrogen Gas
description: (H) Hydrogen Gas is the universe's most common and atomically light element in a Gaseous state.

name: Iridium Gas
description: (Ir) Iridium Gas is a highly conductive Metal heated into a  Gas state.

name: Iron Gas
description: (Fe) Iron Gas is a common industrial Metal, heated into a Gas.

name: Lead Gas
description: (Pb) Lead Gas is a soft yet extremely dense Refined Metal heated into a Gaseous.

name: Mercury Gas
description: (Hg) Mercury Gas is a Metal heated into a Gaseous state.

name: Natural Gas
description:
Natural Gas is a mixture of various alkanes in a Gaseous state.

It is useful in Power production.

name: Nickel Gas
description: (Ni) Nickel Gas is a conductive Metal heated into a Gas state.

name: Niobium Gas
description:
(Nb) Niobium Gas is a rare metal.

This selection is in a Gaseous state.

name: Nuclear Fallout
description: Nuclear Fallout is a highly toxic gas full of Radioactive Contaminants. Condenses into Liquid Nuclear Waste.

name: Oxygen
description:
(O2) Oxygen is an atomically lightweight and breathable Gas, necessary for sustaining life.

It tends to rise above other gases.

name: Phosphorus Gas
description: (P) Phosphorus Gas is the Gaseous state of Refined Phosphorus.

name: Polluted Oxygen
description:
(O2) Polluted Oxygen is dirty, unfiltered air.

It is breathable.

name: Rock Gas
description: Rock Gas is rock that has been superheated into a Gaseous state.

name: Salt Gas
description: (NaCl) Salt Gas is an edible chemical compound that has been superheated into a Gaseous state.

name: Sour Gas
description:
Sour Gas is a hydrocarbon Gas containing high concentrations of hydrogen sulfide.

It is a byproduct of highly heated Petroleum.

name: Steam
description: (H2O) Steam is Water that has been heated into a scalding Gas.

name: Steel Gas
description: Steel Gas is a superheated Metal Gas composed of iron and carbon.

name: Sulfur Gas
description:
(S) Sulfur is a common chemical element and byproduct of Natural Gas production.

This selection is in a Gaseous state.

name: Super Coolant Gas
description:
Super Coolant is an industrial-grade Fullerene coolant.

This selection is in a Gaseous state.

name: Tungsten Gas
description:
(W) Tungsten is a superheated crystalline Metal.

This selection is in a Gaseous state.

name: Zinc Gas
description: (Zn) Zinc Gas is Zinc heated into a Gaseous state.
